messages:
ella: Quick broadcast  we're scheduling a short maintenance window to reclaim leftover routing weights and validate geo-routing fallback. Please ack if this conflicts.

ella: Why: observed small percentage of stale routing weights after emergency repairs; want to run a controlled sweep and a light load verification to ensure no customer impact. Also publishing a short internal note on routing reclamation procedure.

marc: When's the window?

ella: Thu Aug 12 2026 01:30-02:15 UTC. Scope: run routing-weight reclamation job in eu-west-1 + light shaped load to canaries in us-west-2 and ap-southeast-1. We'll simulate one AZ drain in eu-west-1 as part of the check.

nadir: Expected impact?

ella: No planned customer downtime. Canaries may see brief latency bumps and small burst of 5xx during weight reconciliation. We'll pause promotions and disable auto-promote for 01:00-03:00 UTC.

sophia: Monitoring  I'll spin up a temp dashboard with p50/p95/p99, routing mismatch counts, 5xx rate, and kv-cache miss-rate. Pager: 5xx > 10% for 4m or routing mismatch > 0.5% for 5m.

ella: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/routing-reclaim. Abort snippets below for quick copy:
```
# stop shaped load
kubectl scale deploy/shape-load -n stress --replicas=0
# freeze routing changes
infractl routing freeze --region eu-west-1
# revert reclaimed weights
infractl routing restore --from backup --region eu-west-1
```

marc: I'll notify account leads for any high-risk customers and disable promotions. Avoid scheduling promos 00:45-03:00 UTC.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Routing weight reclamation + geo failover check" Thu Aug 12 01:30-02:15 UTC  invites: #eng-sre #eng-runtime #support.

nadir: Acked  I'll be on rotation that night and can join incident channel if anything fires.

sophia: :eyes: will post dashboard links 20m prior.

ella: Thanks. React with :white_check_mark: once read.

marc: :white_check_mark:

nadir: :white_check_mark:

sophia: :white_check_mark:
